# truenas_snapshot_release (Action)

Releases a previously placed hold on a snapshot (pool.snapshot.release).



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `snapshot` (String) Snapshot to release, e.g. "tank/data@snap1".

### Optional

- `recursive` (Boolean) Also release the equivalent snapshot on descendant datasets.
